target.installed_firmware: v42012 (stock 0x97 response; exact binary not recovered)

semantic_evidence.supporting_app_reverse_engineering: Recent Divoom APK decompilation maps 0x97 to SPP_GET_FILE_VERSION; exact current app 3.8.34 independently emitted the same command in the purchased-unit capture.
semantic_evidence.scope: read-only file-version query only; no other command semantics inherited

expected_response.parser_rule: payload[0] must echo firmware selector 0; payload[1:3] little-endian is version; trailing payload byte is retained but not assigned semantics

operation.persistence_effect: read_only_query; no state mutation is requested; exact same request was already emitted by the stock app during normal connection initialization

authority.note: Frozen exact one-request M4. Requires explicit user authority before any custom connect/send.

stop_policy.ambiguous_send_or_timeout: close locally; outcome unknown; no resend
stop_policy.unexpected_response: close locally; preserve bytes; no reinterpretation as success
stop_policy.liveness_loss: close local transmitter; use documented ordinary stock controls only
stop_policy.post_success: close RFCOMM immediately after the single complete response; do not send any second application frame
